concept: Sharing credit and recognizing others' contributions instead of taking all the credit yourself
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student is recognized publicly for a group effort where others contributed significantly
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides how to respond to the recognition — accepting it fully or actively sharing credit
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on how sharing credit affected the group afterward

assessment.success_marker: student can name specific others' contributions, not just a general statement about sharing credit
